# Security

Orion opens files from cameras and the web and can run a local MCP server, so
a malformed file or a request that escapes its folder is worth reporting.

**Report privately:** use **Report a vulnerability** on the
[Security tab](https://github.com/Nano-AI/Orion/security), or email
[alpha@bankoti.dev](mailto:alpha@bankoti.dev). Please don't open a public issue.

Include the Orion version, macOS version, and a file or steps that reproduce
it. You'll get a reply within a week. Only the newest alpha gets fixes.
